content:
Field
Description
ContextTimeStamp System time of event creation.
ContextProcessId
UPID of process originating this event.
ContextThreadId
UTID of thread originating this event
TreeId
If this event is part of a detection tree, the tree ID it is part of.
RequestType
An enum that represents the type of request made for this specificDNS query. See
https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/windows/desktop/cc982162.aspx [https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-
us/library/windows/desktop/cc982162.aspx]
Values:
UNKNOWN (0x0000)
A (0x0001)
NS (0x0002)
CNAME (0x0005)
PTR (0x000C)
MX (0x000F)
TXT (0x0010)
AAAA (0x001C)
ANY (0x00FF)
DomainName
The actual domain name being queried in this request.
AppIdentifier
Unique identifier for the mobile application, package name on android and bundle id on iOS.
IpAddress
An IP address.
